newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's net foreign reserves hit new high.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's net foreign reserves hit new high.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves hit a new all-time high of $9.938 billion in the week ending April 4, the last for which official figures are available, the central bank said.
The last all-time high was recorded in mid-March, when net foreign reserves totalled $9.935 billion.
According to the central bank, Colombia accumulated $41.5 million in net foreign reserves between Jan. 1 and April 4. An accumulation of $750 million is expected throughout 1997.
